home.heroBody: Artisan-roasted in small batches, curated by experts, and delivered straight from the producer to your home.
home.usTitle: Premium Mexican coffee, delivered in the United States
home.usBody: Subscribe just like in Mexico. We ship to all 50 states and DC. You’ll see U.S. pricing in the subscription flow — always charged in Mexican pesos (MXN).

why.roastDesc: We roast in small batches right before each shipment. You’ll never get weeks-old coffee.
why.shipDesc: We deliver across Mexico and also to the United States.
why.localDesc: We work with passionate producers from Oaxaca, Chiapas, Veracruz, and more.
why.flexDesc: No contracts or fine print. Cancel, pause, or change anytime.
why.customDesc: Whole bean, coarse, medium, or fine grind. Your coffee, your brew.
why.qualityDesc: We only select coffees scoring 80+ on the SCA quality scale.

home.plansSubtitle: Cancel, pause, or change anytime. No contracts or fine print. U.S. pricing is shown at checkout.

how.step1Desc: Whole bean, coarse, medium, or fine. Pick what fits your brew method.
how.step2Desc: Tell us where to deliver. We ship to Mexico and the United States.
how.step3Desc: Get freshly roasted coffee every month. Cancel or change anytime.

faqs.a: A monthly delivery service that brings premium, freshly roasted Mexican coffee straight to your home or office.
Depending on your plan you’ll get 250g to 1kg of coffee — always fresh. In Mexico shipping is included; for the U.S., the international fee is calculated at checkout.

faqs.q: Do you ship to the United States?
faqs.a: Yes. We ship to all 50 states and DC. Billing is in Mexican pesos (MXN); your bank may convert to USD.

faqs.q: Can I change grind preference or address?
faqs.a: Yes — update your preferences anytime from your account.
Cancel anytime with no contracts or hidden fees.
We roast in small batches right before each shipment for maximum freshness.

home.ctaBody: Join more than 1,200 coffee lovers already enjoying Bolsadecafé every month.
home.footerBlurb: Premium Mexican coffee, artisan-roasted and delivered to your door every month.
